message: #link V_spec does not resolve: built-in modules are named <std/NAME>
why: Angle-bracket links only resolve against the embedded stdlib, which has a fixed, small member list. Anything else must come from a .hbc on the -L path, and that form uses quotes, not angle brackets.
fix: or link your own archive by module name: #link "yourlib";
